userStories.title: Project settings and members confirmations
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Migrate sites 1 to 5 with exact bilingual confirmation copy.
**Motivation** — After #500, ticket and comment delete use the styled dialog, while 18 other destructive or bulk actions still use the native one. The same app asks the same kind of question two different ways.
**Approach** — The reference migration is `CommentThread.vue` `deleteComment`: `const confirmed = await confirm({ title, body, confirmLabel, destructive: true }); if (!confirmed) return`.
Every other site keeps its function shape and replaces `if (!window.confirm(text)) return` with `if (!(await confirm({ ... }))) return`, making the handler `async` where it is not already.
Each site keeps its existing i18n key as the dialog **title**. Where the existing value holds a second sentence, the title loses it and that sentence moves to a new `<key>Body` key. Where the existing value is a bare question, the body is new text. The confirm button reuses the i18n key of the button that opened the dialog. Only `fleet.config.page.leaveConfirmLabel` is new. Titles marked "unchanged" keep their current en and zh values.

| # | Site (file, function) | Title key (en / zh) | Body key (en / zh) | `confirmLabel` key | `destructive` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `components/SettingsVcsCard.vue` `rotateSecret` | `vcs.secret.rotateConfirm` = "Rotate the webhook secret?" / "确定轮换 Webhook 密钥？" | `vcs.secret.rotateConfirmBody` = "Deliveries signed with the old secret will be rejected." / "使用旧密钥签名的投递将被拒绝。" | `vcs.secret.rotate` | true |
| 2 | `components/SettingsProviderKeysCard.vue` delete | `fleet.providerKeys.deleteConfirm` (unchanged, `{provider}`) | `fleet.providerKeys.deleteConfirmBody` = "The stored key is removed and cannot be recovered." / "已保存的密钥将被移除，且无法恢复。" | `fleet.providerKeys.delete` | true |
| 3 | `components/ProjectInvitesPanel.vue` cancel invite | `projects.invites.cancelConfirm` (unchanged, `{email}`) | `projects.invites.cancelConfirmBody` = "The invite link stops working." / "该邀请链接将失效。" | `projects.invites.cancel` | true |
| 4 | `components/ProjectMembersPanel.vue` `onRemoveRow` | `projects.members.removeConfirm` (unchanged, `{name}`) | `projects.members.removeConfirmBody` = "All of their roles in this project are removed." / "其在此项目中的所有角色将被移除。" | `projects.members.remove` | true |
| 5 | `components/SettingsDangerZoneCard.vue` delete project | `projects.settings.deleteConfirm` = "Delete this project?" / "确认删除此项目？" | `projects.settings.deleteConfirmBody` = "This action cannot be undone." / "此操作不可撤销。" | `projects.settings.delete` | true |

Each story adds the en and zh values for its own rows to `i18n/locales/en.json` and `i18n/locales/zh.json`. Rows 2 and 12 share a body key, and so do rows 8 and 13. The story that owns the first row of a pair adds the key. Row 1 deliberately drops the zh "吗" so that the title is a short question, like the other titles.
Use auto-imported useConfirm and the existing global host. Migrate SettingsProviderKeysCard.spec.ts AC-6/M2, ProjectInvitesPanel.spec.ts AC6, and settings-danger-zone-card.spec.ts AC-7/AC-8 to globals.useConfirm with resolving mocks; assert full options/interpolated titles. Keep origin stubs and existing post-consent behavior. Create the three expected specs. Cancel/Escape/close returns false before any API, toast or state change; confirmed errors keep existing handling. Supersession remains verified by the existing unchanged shared spec, with no new test.
**Scope** — In: five components, their copy and specified Jest work. Out: admin fleet usage is US-003; governance/approval copy is US-002; project pages are US-004; schedules/budgets are US-005; lint is US-006. `useConfirm`, `ConfirmDialogHost` and their tests do not change. No new option (for example an input field or a third button) is added. `CommentThread.vue` and `TicketProperties.vue` were migrated by #500 and are not touched. A second confirm request closing the first one with `false` is existing `useConfirm` behaviour; no story adds a test for it. No new failure-path or E2E tests.
**Interface** — `useConfirm(): { confirm(options: ConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean>; settle(ok: boolean): void; current: ComputedRef<ConfirmOptions | null> }`
`interface ConfirmOptions { title: string; body?: string; confirmLabel?: string; destructive?: boolean }`
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] Clicking rotate in SettingsVcsCard calls confirm once with { title: t('vcs.secret.rotateConfirm'), body: t('vcs.secret.rotateConfirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('vcs.secret.rotate'), destructive: true }.
[unit] In SettingsVcsCard, when confirm resolves false, no POST /projects/:slug/vcs/webhook-secret/rotate request is sent after the promise settles.

[unit] Deleting a key in SettingsProviderKeysCard calls confirm once with { title: t('fleet.providerKeys.deleteConfirm', { provider }), body: t('fleet.providerKeys.deleteConfirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('fleet.providerKeys.delete'), destructive: true }, where provider is the row's providerId.
[unit] In SettingsProviderKeysCard, when confirm resolves false, no delete request is sent after the promise settles.

[unit] Cancelling the invite for pending@x.io in ProjectInvitesPanel calls confirm once with { title: t('projects.invites.cancelConfirm', { email: 'pending@x.io' }), body: t('projects.invites.cancelConfirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('projects.invites.cancel'), destructive: true }.
[unit] In ProjectInvitesPanel, when confirm resolves false, the invite cancel API is not called after the promise settles.

[unit] Removing a member row in ProjectMembersPanel calls confirm once with { title: t('projects.members.removeConfirm', { name }), body: t('projects.members.removeConfirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('projects.members.remove'), destructive: true }, where name is the row's display name.
[unit] In ProjectMembersPanel, when confirm resolves false, no binding is removed after the promise settles.

[unit] Deleting the project in SettingsDangerZoneCard calls confirm once with { title: t('projects.settings.deleteConfirm'), body: t('projects.settings.deleteConfirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('projects.settings.delete'), destructive: true }.
[unit] In SettingsDangerZoneCard, when confirm resolves false, no project delete request is sent after the promise settles.

[unit] The en and zh locale files hold the exact Design table values embedded in this story for the row 1 to 5 keys: vcs.secret.rotateConfirm, projects.settings.deleteConfirm, vcs.secret.rotateConfirmBody, fleet.providerKeys.deleteConfirmBody, projects.invites.cancelConfirmBody, projects.members.removeConfirmBody and projects.settings.deleteConfirmBody.

routing.reasoning: Standard existing-pattern component migrations; key rotation, credential deletion and role removal require strict security test isolation. Write mounted/options/cancellation and literal locale tests first, migrating existing mocks without changing shared tests.

modifiedFiles.reason: tests "AC-6" and "M2" stub `window.confirm` and read its string argument. They switch to a `useConfirm` global whose `confirm` mock resolves `false`/`true`. "M2" asserts that the `title` option interpolates `{provider}`.

test "AC6" drives `window.confirm` and checks that its message names the invite email. It switches to a `useConfirm` global and asserts that the `title` option contains `pending@x.io`. Cancel is called only when `confirm` resolves `true`.

"AC-7" asserts `window.confirm` was called with `'projects.settings.deleteConfirm'`, and "AC-8" declines through `window.confirm`. Both switch to a `useConfirm` global. AC-7 asserts the `confirm` options object, and AC-8 resolves `false` with no delete.

userStories.title: Project page confirmations and the nax-file leave guard
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Migrate sites 13 to 16 and await styled consent in the unsaved-edit route guard.
**Motivation** — F6: the browser can suppress `window.confirm`, its OS-styled box ignores the app theme and dark mode, and the one sentence it shows mixes the question with its consequence.
**Approach** — `pages/[project]/fleet/repos/[id]/config.vue` leave guard.
Baseline: `onBeforeRouteLeave(() => { if (submitted.value || edits.value.length === 0) return true; return window.confirm(t('fleet.config.page.leaveConfirm')) })`.
Target: an `async` guard that returns `true` for a clean or submitted draft without asking, and otherwise returns the boolean that `confirm(...)` resolves to. Vue Router accepts a `Promise<boolean>` from a leave guard.
The baseline only locates the code. It is never the interface to implement. Every other site keeps its function shape and replaces `if (!window.confirm(text)) return` with `if (!(await confirm({ ... }))) return`, making the handler `async` where it is not already.

| # | Site (file, function) | Title key (en / zh) | Body key (en / zh) | `confirmLabel` key | `destructive` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | `pages/[project]/approval-policies.vue` delete policy | `approvals.policies.list.deleteConfirm` (unchanged, `{pattern}`) | `approvals.policies.list.deleteConfirmBody` (row 8) | `approvals.policies.list.delete` | true |
| 14 | `pages/[project]/flows/[id].vue` `stopFlow` | `fleet.flows.stop.confirm` (unchanged) | `fleet.flows.stop.confirmBody` = "The flow does not continue to its next step." / "该流程将不再继续下一步。" | `fleet.flows.stop.button` | true |
| 15 | `pages/[project]/kb.vue` delete document source | `kb.documents.deleteConfirm` (unchanged) | `kb.documents.deleteConfirmBody` = "Its indexed content is removed from search." / "其已索引内容将从搜索中移除。" | `common.delete` | true |
| 16 | `pages/[project]/fleet/repos/[id]/config.vue` leave guard | `fleet.config.page.leaveConfirm` = "Leave with unsaved changes?" / "离开并丢弃未保存的改动？" | `fleet.config.page.leaveConfirmBody` = "Your edits to nax files are lost." / "你对 nax 文件的改动将丢失。" | `fleet.config.page.leaveConfirmLabel` (new) = "Leave" / "离开" | true |

Reuse US-002's body unchanged: `approvals.policies.list.deleteConfirmBody` = "Actions it covers no longer ask for approval under this policy." / "其覆盖的操作将不再按此策略请求审批。". Titles marked "unchanged" keep their current en and zh values. Add only row 14-16 copy to both locales. Use auto-imported useConfirm/global host unchanged. Migrate tests/pages/project-approval-policies.spec.ts and fleet-flow-stop.spec.ts to globals.useConfirm; replace declined flow mockReturnValue(false) with mockResolvedValue(false). Capture the registered guard in fleet-repo-config-page.spec.ts and test actual clean, edited, declined/accepted and successful submitted-with-edits states. Add the KB behavior and project copy specs. The delete button (`kb.vue`, `common.delete` label) has no `data-testid`, so the spec finds it by its label or `variant`. Preserve flow permission/live/busy guards, finally reload, KB 403 handling and all error paths. Cancel returns before APIs/toasts/state changes.
**Scope** — In: four project pages, async guard, related tests and row 14-16 copy. Out: admin approval/body ownership is US-002; settings is US-001; admin fleet is US-003; budgets/schedules are US-005; lint is US-006. Closing or reloading the browser tab with unsaved nax-file edits is not guarded (there is no `beforeunload` handler today, and none is added). `useConfirm`, `ConfirmDialogHost` and their tests do not change. No new option (for example an input field or a third button) is added. The error toast and refresh path after a confirmed API call fails is unchanged at every site; no story adds tests for it beyond what each site's existing spec already has. No new E2E tests.
**Interface** — `useConfirm(): { confirm(options: ConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean>; settle(ok: boolean): void; current: ComputedRef<ConfirmOptions | null> }`
`interface ConfirmOptions { title: string; body?: string; confirmLabel?: string; destructive?: boolean }`
The leave guard returns `Promise<boolean>`.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] Deleting a policy on pages/[project]/approval-policies.vue calls confirm once with { title: t('approvals.policies.list.deleteConfirm', { pattern }), body: t('approvals.policies.list.deleteConfirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('approvals.policies.list.delete'), destructive: true }.
[unit] On the project approval policies page, when confirm resolves false, no project policy DELETE is sent after the promise settles.

[unit] Stopping a live flow on pages/[project]/flows/[id].vue calls confirm once with { title: t('fleet.flows.stop.confirm'), body: t('fleet.flows.stop.confirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('fleet.flows.stop.button'), destructive: true }.
[unit] On the flow page, when confirm resolves false, flows.stop is not called after the promise settles.

[unit] Deleting a document source on pages/[project]/kb.vue calls confirm once with { title: t('kb.documents.deleteConfirm'), body: t('kb.documents.deleteConfirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('common.delete'), destructive: true }.
[unit] On the KB page, when confirm resolves false, no document delete request is sent after the promise settles.
[unit] On pages/[project]/fleet/repos/[id]/config.vue with no edits, the leave guard returns true without calling confirm.

[unit] On the config page with one unsaved edit, the leave guard calls confirm once with { title: t('fleet.config.page.leaveConfirm'), body: t('fleet.config.page.leaveConfirmBody'), confirmLabel: t('fleet.config.page.leaveConfirmLabel'), destructive: true }.
[unit] On the config page with one unsaved edit, the leave guard resolves false when confirm resolves false.
[unit] On the config page with one unsaved edit, the leave guard resolves true when confirm resolves true.
[unit] On the config page after a submit (submitted is true) with edits present, the leave guard returns true without calling confirm.

[unit] The en and zh locale files hold the exact Design table values embedded in this story for the row 14 to 16 keys: fleet.config.page.leaveConfirm, fleet.flows.stop.confirmBody, kb.documents.deleteConfirmBody, fleet.config.page.leaveConfirmBody and fleet.config.page.leaveConfirmLabel.

routing.reasoning: Standard page migrations and async Vue Router guard, with governance invoking the security override. Write failing mounted options/cancellation/copy assertions and capture the real guard to exercise clean, dirty and submitted state.

modifiedFiles.reason: `mountPage` builds a `confirm` mock on `window`. It moves that mock to a `useConfirm` global resolving the same boolean.
`confirm` is a `window.confirm` mock and "AC-4" declines with `mockReturnValue(false)`. It becomes a `useConfirm` global whose mock resolves the boolean (`mockResolvedValue(false)`).
the `onBeforeRouteLeave: () => undefined` global discards the guard. It captures the registered guard so the new leave-guard tests can call it, and adds a `useConfirm` global.

userStories.title: Schedule and budget delete confirmations
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Migrate sites 17 and 18, adapt both budget callers, add copy and update the existing browser delete step.
**Motivation** — After #500, ticket and comment delete use the styled dialog, while 18 other destructive or bulk actions still use the native one. The same app asks the same kind of question two different ways.
**Approach** — Changed symbols. The baseline only locates the code. It is never the interface to implement.
- `composables/useFleetBudgetPage.ts` `remove`.
  Baseline: `remove(policy: BudgetPolicyDto, confirmText: string): Promise<void>`, which calls `window.confirm(confirmText)`.
  Target: `remove(policy: BudgetPolicyDto, prompt: { title: string; body: string }): Promise<void>`, which awaits `confirm({ title: prompt.title, body: prompt.body, confirmLabel: t('fleet.budgets.actions.delete'), destructive: true })`.

userStories.title: Lint ban on native confirm
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Reject native confirms in web source after all migrations.
**Motivation** — Nothing stops new code from adding another `window.confirm`.
**Approach** — `apps/web/.eslintrc.cjs` gains two top-level rules:
- `no-restricted-properties` with the entries `{ object: 'window', property: 'confirm' }` and `{ object: 'globalThis', property: 'confirm' }`, each with the message 'Use useConfirm() (styled dialog) instead of the native confirm.'
- `no-restricted-globals` with `{ name: 'confirm', message: 'Use useConfirm() (styled dialog) instead of the global confirm().' }`.
The existing `*.spec.ts` override turns both rules off, because specs build fake `window` objects. A local `confirm` (destructured from `useConfirm()`, or a local function as in `ThreadStaleBanner.vue`) is not a global, so `no-restricted-globals` does not flag it. The shared preset sets `env.browser: true`, so `confirm` is a known global and the rule applies. `bun run lint` (`--max-warnings=0`) then fails on any new native confirm in `apps/web` source.
**No-test:** an ESLint configuration change, enforced by the existing `bun run lint` gate. No runtime code loads it.
Set both top-level severities to error and both rules off in the existing spec override; preserve Vue parsing. Review the configuration and native-confirm rejection criteria, and verify with the existing apps/web lint gate; create/modify no tests.
**Scope** — In: apps/web/.eslintrc.cjs only. Out: source migrations/copy are US-001 through US-005. Do not change shared presets, package scripts or existing styled dialogs. Updating `.nax/mono/apps/web/context.md` with a "no window.confirm; use useConfirm" note is a manual edit after merge, not story work (`.nax/` is read-only to the run).
**Interface** — ESLint entries: `{ object: 'window', property: 'confirm' }`, `{ object: 'globalThis', property: 'confirm' }`, `{ name: 'confirm', message: 'Use useConfirm() (styled dialog) instead of the global confirm().' }`. No runtime TypeScript change.

[review] apps/web/.eslintrc.cjs top-level rules sets no-restricted-globals to error, with the entry { name: 'confirm' } and a message that names useConfirm().
[review] The existing files: ['*.spec.ts'] override in apps/web/.eslintrc.cjs sets both no-restricted-properties and no-restricted-globals to off.
